title: In an abstract Setoid-flavored ring, an element times negative one is equivalent to its negation
statement: For any AlgS.Ring record R (an abstract carrier, a caller-supplied equivalence relation equiv with congruence fields for add/mul/neg, additive commutative group and distributive laws stated over equiv rather than Eq) and any x of R's carrier, equiv (mul x (neg one)) (neg x) -- proved self-contained in the ring calculus (no Group-level uniqueness theorem borrowed, since AlgS carries none), by deriving equiv (add (mul x (neg one)) x) zero from distribL plus the already-proved AlgS.mul_zero plus mulOneR, then chaining through the additive-group identities that both mul x (neg one) and neg x are additive inverses of x.

formal.statement: theorem AlgS.mul_neg_one : ((x0 : AlgS.Ring) -> ((x1 : AlgS.Ring.carrier x0) -> AlgS.Ring.equiv x0 (AlgS.Ring.mul x0 x1 (AlgS.Ring.neg x0 (AlgS.Ring.one x0))) (AlgS.Ring.neg x0 x1)))

evidence.supports: AlgS.mul_neg_one admits through the trusted kernel gate, with an empty axiom footprint, and instantiated at AlgS.Ring.ofAlg(Int.ring) (concrete at Int.zero and closed over a free `a`), at CReal.commRingS's AlgS.CommRing.toRingS projection, and at Complex.commRingS's AlgS.CommRing.toRingS projection -- each applied at a genuinely free carrier element and confirmed to type-check.
evidence.checker_command: out=$(RUST_MIN_STACK=1073741824 cargo test -p axeyum-lean-kernel --lib --release -- mul_neg_one_instantiated_at_int_through_ofalg_concrete_and_symbolic generic_mul_neg_one_instantiated_at_creal_type_checks_concrete_and_symbolic generic_mul_neg_one_instantiated_at_complex_type_checks_concrete_and_symbolic --test-threads=1 2>&1) && test "$(printf "%s\n" "$out" | grep -cE 'test result: ok\. 3 passed; 0 failed')" -ge 1
evidence.notes: The pinned pattern requires the exact count ('3 passed; 0 failed') across all three instantiation tests, not merely a nonzero pass.

provenance.established_by: axeyum-lean-kernel nat_prelude::structures_setoid (declare_mul_neg_one), lane structures-unify, ADR-1590 -- one more Setoid-flavored generic theorem, instantiated at three carriers.
provenance.source: crates/axeyum-lean-kernel/src/nat_prelude/structures_setoid.rs (declare_mul_neg_one, declared as AlgS.mul_neg_one); crates/axeyum-lean-kernel/src/creal/algebra_instance.rs and crates/axeyum-lean-kernel/src/complex/algebra_instance.rs (the CReal/Complex instantiation tests).

notes: The Setoid-flavored twin of F:alg-mul-neg-one (ADR-1584). Unlike that theorem's proof (which projects Alg.Ring down to Alg.Group and applies Alg.groupInvUnique), this one stays entirely within AlgS.Ring's own fields, since AlgS carries no Group-level generic theorem to borrow. Int has no retirement target under this name (Int.neg_one_mul is the mirrored left form); CReal/Complex have no named carrier theorem at all, so both instantiations are well-typedness measurements.
